name: Jamaica
blurb: Climb the limestone terraces of Dunn's River Falls, then eat jerk chicken smoked over pimento wood in Boston Bay.

name: Dominican Republic
blurb: Santo Domingo's Zona Colonial is the oldest European-built city in the Americas, and Pico Duarte is the Caribbean's highest peak.

name: Bahamas
blurb: Swim with the wild pigs of Big Major Cay in the Exumas and dive Andros, home to the world's densest cluster of blue holes.

name: Puerto Rico
blurb: Walk the 500-year-old walls of El Morro in Old San Juan, then hike El Yunque, the only tropical rainforest in the US Forest Service.

name: Barbados
blurb: Home of rum since the 1600s, with Harrison's Cave running under the island and flying fish and cou-cou on every menu.

name: Turks and Caicos
blurb: Grace Bay Beach fronts a barrier reef system that is among the largest on earth, with a wall that drops off just offshore.

name: St. Lucia
blurb: The twin volcanic Pitons rise straight out of the sea near Soufrière, next to a sulphur springs field you can drive right into.

name: Aruba
blurb: A dry, cactus-covered island outside the hurricane belt, where steady trade winds bend the divi-divi trees and make Arikok's coast wild.
